investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Coralshore Mobility (ride-hailing); Platform: Google Cloud us-central1 (zones us-central1-a/us-central1-b/us-central1-c/us-central1-f); network range 10.248.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster corals-prod-uscent (GKE); Database: mysql server pricing-db-01 reachable from the application network only through firewall rule allow-pricing-to-db; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
